claims.claim_text: ServiceTitan holds 14 issued U.S. patents, four issued foreign patents, and nine U.S. patent applications, plus non-U.S. applications, protecting its trades-software technology.
claims.subject: ServiceTitan, Inc.
claims.source_quote: 14 issued U.S. patents, four issued foreign patents, nine U.S. patent applications and seven patent applications in various non-U.S. jurisdictions

claims.claim_text: Approximately $62.0 billion of Gross Transaction Volume (GTV) was processed on the ServiceTitan platform for the twelve months ended July 31, 2024.
claims.subject: ServiceTitan platform
claims.source_quote: We are focused on expanding the $62.0 billion of GTV processed on our platform for the twelve months ended July 31, 2024.

claims.claim_text: ServiceTitan had approximately 8,000 Active Customers (customers with >$10,000 annualized billings) as of July 31, 2024, representing over 96% of annualized billings, with net dollar retention rate of over 110%.
claims.subject: ServiceTitan, Inc.
claims.source_quote: approximately 6,800 Active Customers and approximately 8,000 Active Customers, respectively, representing over 95% and over 96% of our annualized billings ... net dollar retention rate of over 110%

claims.claim_text: ServiceTitan earns FinTech revenue through revenue-sharing agreements with third-party payment processing and end-customer (consumer) financing partners.

claims.object_value: revenue-sharing agreements with payment processing and financing partners
claims.source_quote: revenue sharing agreements with payment processing and end-customer financing partners, and we recognize this revenue on a net basis

claims.claim_text: ServiceTitan acquired FieldRoutes (FSH Topco, LLC dba PestRoutes), a cloud SaaS pest-control provider, in February 2022 for purchase consideration of $576.9 million in cash.
claims.subject: ServiceTitan, Inc.
claims.source_quote: In February 2022, the Company acquired 100% of the membership interests of FSH Topco, LLC dba PestRoutes ("FieldRoutes") ... for purchase consideration of $576.9 million in cash

claims.claim_text: The material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting first identified in fiscal 2019 have been remediated as of the end of fiscal 2024; the company is a going concern with sufficient liquidity for at least 12 months.
claims.subject: ServiceTitan, Inc.
claims.object_value: material weaknesses remediated FY2024; no going-concern doubt
claims.source_quote: The material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting, which we first identified in fiscal 2019, have been remediated as of the end of fiscal 2024.

claims.claim_text: ServiceTitan conducts material operations (R&D / engineering) in Armenia, in addition to the United States and Canada.
claims.subject: ServiceTitan, Inc.
claims.source_quote: Our expenses are generally denominated in the currencies of the jurisdictions in which we conduct our operations, which are primarily in the United States, Armenia and Canada.
